name: easyscreenshot
description: Give it a website and it picks the pages worth showing, then saves clean desktop, phone and full-page screenshots your coding agent can use.

interface.longDescription: Opens a product's website in the Chrome, Chromium, Edge or Brave you already have, picks the pages worth showing, hides cookie banners and chat bubbles, and saves desktop, phone and full-page PNGs with manifest.json and SCREENSHOTS.md. Needs Node 22 or newer and no API key.
